checklist.detail: OK - primary hoop stress ~45 MPa (~13.0 MPa net jacket-vs-gas differential, Huzel eq 4-27/4-28, tube_wall) vs a ~67 MPa allowable at the throat (Stainless Steel (304/316), SF 1.5, wall ~0.20 mm). The thermal-restraint stress (~736 MPa at the throat, dT = q*t/k across the wall) is a self-limiting secondary stress, not a burst load: with the hoop load it exceeds Stainless Steel (304/316)'s ~100 MPa hot yield, so the hot face yields a little each firing - expected for a regen tube wall (the real F-1/J-2/RL10 do the same in this model). Its life limit is the 'Throat thermal-fatigue cycle life' row.
